messages.content: Write a short announcement for a new feature in a note-taking app: offline sync. Around 200 words.

I'll write a clean announcement that avoids the common writing patterns that read as AI-generated.

---

**Offline Sync: Your Notes, Always Accessible**

Your notes are now available everywhere, even without internet. We've rebuilt how the app handles data so it works just as well offline as it does online.

When you're offline, you create, edit, and organize notes exactly as usual. The app stores everything locally on your device. Once you reconnect, it syncs your changes across all your devices—no manual uploads, no merge conflicts, no waiting.

We kept this simple on purpose. Offline sync works the same way online sync does. You don't need to think about it or change how you work. Just open your notes and write.

We tested this with unreliable connections too—dropping offline and reconnecting repeatedly. The app handles it gracefully. If two devices edit the same note while disconnected, we show you both versions so you can pick what matters.

This works on phones, tablets, and computers. Your full note library is available offline on each device, or just the folders you choose—whatever fits your storage.

We've been working on this since people asked us to fix syncing issues last spring. That feedback made us rebuild this from the ground up. It's more reliable and faster than before.

Offline sync is available now in version 4.2.

---
